column1: # Test routes: the runs every gate uses (tools/s11.sh test / compare / mutate; DECOMP.md 5, 6, 11). Columns: name,
# frames, pad script (hle_io.c: "F[+N][@P]:BTN|BTN,...": buttons held on port P (default 0 = A) during frames F..F+N-1,
# N default 4; "0@1:" plugs a controller into port B with nothing pressed; SL/SR/SU/SD = the stick pushed fully;
# '-' = no input), extra runtime arguments ('-' = none). Each run must reach its frame limit.
# boot: power-on, logos, title, the attract demo (mode 8, from 2230) and its 3600-frame time-out, the title again
boot
# route (S4): title, TRICELON, PenPen House, RACE, character, course map, a 1P race on Easy Icelon from 1766; S12: the
# pause at 5850, then the soft reset on controller A at 5900 (A+B+X+Y held, Start): back to the title, unpaused
route
# explore (S12): the stick in the character select and in the race, the pause menu (Retry, Resume), pause again ->
# PenPen House, DRESS UP, RESULTS, back (B) to the title, TIME TRIAL, its race from 5604
# S15: explore pokes the three score tables and the per-character bytes at 1100 (cup2's values): the
# RESULTS screen and the house sum and rank non-zero scores
explore
# vs2 (S12): two controllers; VS ICELON, 2 Pen, both players pick, a two-player race (split mode 2: two views +
# panel) from 2314, both steering, player 2 pauses and resumes
vs2
# vs4 (S12): four controllers; VS ICELON, 4 Pen, a four-player race (split mode 3: four views + panel) from 2314
vs4
# demo (S12): no input until the attract demo runs (from 2230), Start at 2600 ends it: back to the title
demo
# reset (S12): the 1P race, then the soft reset (A+B+X+Y held, Start) on controller B at 2620: back to the title
reset
# inputs (S12, for mutants the other routes miss): during the logos and the title, the stick pushed exactly to the
# d-pad threshold (64: not a direction) each way; partial soft-reset combos (one button missing) on controllers B
# and A; controller B pulled out while it held A+B; controller B without analog axes, with only
# the X axis, with only the Y axis; nothing may change the run
inputs
# cup2..cup4 (S14): the save record's unlock flags set at 1100 in PenPen House (--poke: every flag and course flag
# on; the house has loaded the record by then; cup2 also sets the three score tables and the per-character bytes to
# small distinct values), RACE, the character, then RIGHT on the cup select (1, 2 or 3 times) for the second,
# third, fourth cup, its Easy course raced from ~1830 (A held, steering left then right)
cup2
cup3
cup4
# goodnight (S14): PenPen House's GOOD NIGHT: Game mode 4 (its scene: the save), then back to the title at ~2000
# S15: goodnight also pokes the scores (the scene's penguin is score table a's best: not the first) and runs on
# 2000-06-15 (--rtc: the save's weekday from a month other than January)
goodnight
# options (S18): Game mode 12, the language set-up, which the title menu cannot reach (its choice 3 is never set):
# next_mode (Game at 0x8CE16B00, +0x10) poked to 12 on the title; the cursor moved every way, B leaves; then mode 12
# again, the cursor moved, A sets the language and saves (no VMU), back to the title
options
# gallery (S18): Game mode 12's neighbour, mode 11 (the picture gallery): its files (8098gallery.pvm, the pictures')
# are not on this disc (the US release): the scene's file name and two pictures' names poked to 4000config.pvm, two
# pictures unlocked (save flags 0x8C1B7F50), next_mode poked to 11; every direction, A twice (the number hidden and
# shown), Start back to the title
gallery
# staffroll (S18): Game mode 9, the staff roll (on hardware: after a cup is won, RaceSetup state 4): next_mode poked to
# 9 on the title (its texlist loads through the HLE's njLoadTexture, S18); each phase's countdown (the scene at
# 0x8CE169C0, +0x28) poked short three times so that phase 4 comes; Start leaves for mode 4 (GOOD NIGHT)
staffroll
